items.stem: Explain why the number of arrangements of n objects of which k are identical is n!/k!.

items.stem: Use mathematical induction to prove that Σ from r = 1 to n of r(r + 1) = n(n + 1)(n + 2)/3, n ≥ 1.

items.stem: Explain why both the basis and the inductive step are needed in proof by induction.
